Following that, try to take a trip north. And then, make an attempt to take a trip north. After that, attempt to take a trip north. If you can do that, move east. After that, go to the east. And then, attempt to go east. With that accomplished, attempt to head east. Then, travel north. Following that, make an attempt to go north. Then, take a trip north. And then, move north.
